activity.notes: Multuggerah was a young Aboriginal headman and major resistance leader in the Lockyer Valley, Darling Downs and upper Brisbane regions. The Australian Dictionary of Biography notes that his homeland is claimed by Yugara/Jagera, western Wakka Wakka, Giabal and other groups; ATLAS therefore does not portray him as the sovereign ruler of a single 'Jagera state'. The Activity represents the inter-group western Moreton resistance alliance from the onset of hostilities in the early 1840s to his death in September 1846.

sources.title: Multuggerah (c. 1820–c. 1846) — Australian Dictionary of Biography
sources.citation_text: The ADB identifies Multuggerah as an Aboriginal warrior, resistance leader and headman, documents his multi-group alliance and resistance from the early 1840s until his death in September 1846, and notes the contested/multiple cultural claims to his homeland.
